rationale: Critical questions about bias and evidence need a real opinion text; mirror/window/path illustrations would literalize section names instead of testing credibility.
The effect is verbal brevity and repeated response. An anger face repeats the title and an action sequence would replace analysis of the hadith with an invented scenario.
The target is audible rhyme and regret. No full verse or scansion is supplied; a father-and-infant scene would select an emotional interpretation rather than demonstrate the music.
The moral contrast needs paired poetic actions as evidence. The summary names blame and defence but supplies no matched lines for an accurate contrast diagram.
The last-lesson discovery drives regret. A filled plot image would repeat the stated revelation and predetermine the student reading of atmosphere; clock icon already exists.
The expected/actual gap is intentionally filled by students. No concrete manoeuvre event is given for a useful visual, and a generic surprise panel would duplicate the four cards.
Before/after visit expectations require the story. An invented inspector scene would decide facts and spoil the reveal without clarifying a concrete concept.
Development of leisure as opportunity needs textual details and voice. No dated stages are supplied, so an invented life timeline would be false precision.
The sample of 1000 is an example to interrogate, not a dataset with categories. No defensible bar chart can be drawn from sample size alone.
The success discussion asks listeners to weigh actual arguments. No opinions or evidence are transcribed for a faithful comparison; podium imagery would not teach the judgment.
National development examples must come from the recording. No countries, dates or measurements are given for a grounded map or comparison chart.
Edison listening analysis depends on pace, pauses and tone. A portrait or lightbulb cannot demonstrate those audible features and no waveform segment is supplied.
A one-minute teaching demonstration already has opening/example/close and a performance rubric. Teacher imagery would be a topic label rather than a model of effective explanation.
Students choose an Arab scientist for a sourced talk. Selecting a portrait here would choose the subject for them without adding evidence or delivery guidance.
The anger essay already distinguishes explanation from problem/solution. A generic anger picture would not model evidence, and an invented medical causal chain exceeds the writing example.
The diary task asks students to construct a character viewpoint. An illustrated Last Lesson scene would supply sensory and plot choices that the task leaves to the writer.
The autobiography depends on the student selecting a real personal experience. A ready-made life scene or sequence would displace that selection; planning steps already visible.
Added aligned original and pattern characters; blue extra letters remain unchanged, purple roots map to fa/ayn/lam.

The intasara/yantasiru/muntasir transformation is already a complete worked derivation. A victor illustration would confuse meaning with morphological formation, and a second chain adds no new relation.
Added aligned mursil/mursal contrast showing kasra/fatha explicitly with meaning, matching the exact lesson example.
Knowledge as light is a figurative assertion. A lamp picture would literalize it; the summary already identifies retained and omitted comparison elements without a full image to unpack.
Media integration needs a matched text, chart and clip. None of their data is supplied, so a dashboard would invent evidence instead of evaluate sufficiency.
The target is address, command, prohibition and reasoning in advice. Father-child imagery would infer a scene and add nothing to the linguistic distinctions already labelled.
The wisdom of changing fortunes needs the verse and context. No dated biographical details or full lines support a timeline or musical annotation.
Added qualified poetic writing-shape comparison; blocks explicitly not words or metrical feet.
The abaya is a literary symbol whose meaning differs by character. A fashion image would imply an unspecified cut or colour and would not establish the contested interpretation.
The route lesson analyses narration, description, information and impression. No stops or itinerary are given for a historically reliable map of Ibn Battuta in China.
The biographer source-evaluation task names oral accounts and documents but no actual document. A manuscript image would be a decorative proxy for evidence not supplied.
The 1000 km/h example is explicitly questioned as tested versus expected. A speed chart would wrongly elevate it to confirmed comparable performance; no matched operating data supplied.
Purposeful versus hurtful humour is judged from evidence and effect. Laughing-face imagery would not distinguish the ethical cases; invented jokes would change the lesson content.
The animal-vision prompt requires the recording and actual species. A false-colour human photograph would present an unsupported model rather than compare the arguments heard.
Charisma here is a listening-argument task, not a visual trait. An assertive speaker portrait would imply a stereotype instead of grounded evidence.
Future-planning opinions come from the recording. A calendar or goal staircase would pre-answer the topic and duplicate structure without a supplied plan.
The presentation concerns honouring parents in a technology setting, but students choose examples and evidence. A family-device scene would decide those examples without modelling delivery.
Diabetes is a student-researched speaking topic, with no clinical explanation given here. A disease diagram would introduce medical claims instead of teaching the specified speaking rubric.
The nursing talk is assessed through organization and delivery. A nurse portrait labels the occupation but cannot demonstrate a sourced example or effective oral performance.
Leadership writing asks the learner to select inspiring leaders and evidence. A ready-made leader portrait or ladder would preselect the subject rather than support explanatory form.
The happiness essay requires evidence from the earlier text. No measures or factor weights are supplied for a valid chart, and smiling-face decoration would narrow the concept.
The two-object sentence is already fully parsed with each role. Another word box would repeat the existing worked example; no further spatial relation is needed.
Deleting the verb tests whether two objects form a valid nominal sentence. A snowy landscape illustrates the words but not that grammatical test and would not improve the contrast.
The all-of-book emphasis has a complete case explanation. Shading a whole rectangle would label totality but not distinguish emphasis from the already-taught part-whole relation.
Three mosque phrases visibly contrast indefinite, definite and possessive genitive forms. A mosque image cannot show the case endings, and a repeated table adds no new reasoning.
The five-and-ten gender example is already explicit with the counted noun. Student silhouettes would be countable but distract from grammatical agreement and repeat the number.
The smiling morning example reconstructs the omitted human comparison. A face on a sun would literalize personification; the verbal analysis already identifies the missing term.
The novel introduction asks questions about idea, events and character. A generic prince or planet would give an unsupported visual interpretation before reading.
Added licensed Indonesia locator map in red with world inset. It supplies location only, not invented population data.
Tin is the listening subject but no specimen, use or argument is transcribed. A metallic lump is not visually diagnostic and does not teach weighing the recording evidence.
The student chooses friendship, responsibility or adulthood for a talk. A novel scene would choose the interpretation for them; planning and rubric are already present.
The reading autobiography must use the student own experience and book choice. A generic bookshelf only labels reading and does not model truthful personal detail.

The snake/hat ambiguity is itself the first interpretive reveal. A completed picture would fix the answer before prediction, while neither original artwork nor a new depiction is needed to understand the stated contrast.
Desert isolation is analysed symbolically. An arbitrary desert photograph would introduce unmentioned terrain and aircraft details and would not establish the narrator frame.
Baobab roots destroying a tiny planet are a fictional symbol, not botanical scale. A real tree photo would not represent the relation; the supplied verbal contrast already explains the warning.
The rose becomes a character and a relationship symbol. A stock rose cannot demonstrate the emotional change and may overfix details not given in the modelling text.
The planet figures are parallel social critiques, not a supplied route order. Character icons would repeat labels and a journey map would imply unsupported sequence.
Students place read events on a plot curve and revise predictions. A filled curve would invent event positions and tensions and would take over the inference task.
The unique rose is valued through care rather than appearance. A single differently coloured rose among others would visibly contradict that point; identical icons add no relationship evidence.
The reversal of teacher and learner is already stated as expected versus actual. An adult-child picture cannot show wisdom and would duplicate rather than explain the irony.
The ending is intentionally open. A return journey or definitive star scene would settle an interpretation the lesson asks students to support with textual evidence.
The character-development task needs beginning/end traits with a supporting event. No matched traits are supplied for a filled change diagram; students must produce them.
The seminar roles are already parallel labelled cards. A seating plan would imply a room arrangement not required for evidence, listening or respectful discussion.
The final project explicitly offers a new chapter, letter, analysis or illustrated presentation. A ready-made planet image would bias the open creative choice and not improve assessment criteria.
